data.name: Eshelman
data.gender_notes: Eshelman is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Eshelman is derived from the Hebrew roots ‘esh’ (God) and ‘helam’ (tabernacle or shelter). This name represents the divine protection and dwelling place of God, evoking a sense of security and faith. The name Eshelman carries the meaning “God's Tabernacle or God's Shelter” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Eshelman usually hope their child will grow to embody god's tabernacle or god's shelter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name rooted in faith and divine protection.
data.etymology: Eshelman belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Tabernacle or God's Shelter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eshelman total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

The name invites an individual to remember the divine and seek strength and comfort in their faith as God is their tabernacle and refuge. It serves as a constant reminder to always trust in God and stay close to His presence.
